'''Carina''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Carina was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At some point during her employ with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] (SIS), she was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During that time, her [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] named [[TC-93]] went rogue and fled to [[Network Security District]] with top secret SIS intel. She tasked a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to wipe out the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] memory and bring a copy of the data. In order to succeed, she gave the spacer a scanner to use on the renegade security droids in the district.<ref name="TOR" />
